record.question: 'Y' makes a gift deed in favour of 'A'. The gift deed contains transfer of three houses unburdened by obligations, two houses which are mortgaged with 'S', two cars under the hire purchase agreement and three horses, one of which is lame. Which of the following statements will apply?
options: A can choose to take gift of three houses and avoid all the rest
A has a choice to take over movable property and avoid immovable property
A can accept the whole gift, he has an option to accepting or not accepting the same house
A must accept the whole gift or refuse the same
